observation.command:
cd /workspace
git ls-tree -r FETCH_HEAD --name-only | grep "resources/js/components" | grep -i -E "user|menu"
echo "=== count files in sync tree ==="
git ls-tree -r FETCH_HEAD --name-only | grep -c "resources/js"
echo "=== does sync tree have AppSidebar? ==="
git ls-tree -r FETCH_HEAD --name-only | grep -E "AppSidebar.vue|NavUser.vue|UserInfo"
echo "=== diff component lists ==="
git ls-tree -r HEAD --name-only | grep "resources/js/components/" | grep -v "ui/" > /tmp/head_c.txt
git ls-tree -r FETCH_HEAD --name-only | grep "resources/js/components/" | grep -v "ui/" > /tmp/sync_c.txt
diff /tmp/head_c.txt /tmp/sync_c.txt
